definitions.explanation: Designed for or intended for use in the home, as opposed to commercial, industrial, or professional use. A very common modifier on product labels, advertisements, and in everyday conversation.

examples.japanese: {家庭用|かていよう}⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: Home video game consoles are popular.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{家庭用|かていよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧です。

⟦{業務用|ぎょうむよう}→業務用：13148_gyoumuyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{家庭用|かていよう}で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{容量|ようりょう}→容量：04887_youryou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: The capacity and price are vastly different between commercial and household products.

notes:
USAGE:
Functions as a pre-noun modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or directly before a noun. Part of a productive pattern: {家庭用|かていよう} (household), ⟦{業務用|ぎょうむよう}→業務用：13148_gyoumuyou⟧ (commercial), {工業用|こうぎょうよう} (industrial). Extremely common on product packaging and in stores.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {家庭用|かていよう}⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (home game console)
- {家庭用|かていよう}⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧ (household detergent)
- {家庭用|かていよう}⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧ (household electrical appliances)
- {家庭用|かていよう}⟦{蓄電池|ちくでんち}→蓄電池：08095_chikudenchi⟧ (home storage battery)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{業務用|ぎょうむよう}→業務用：13148_gyoumuyou⟧: for commercial/business use — larger quantities, professional grade
- ⟦{個人用|こじんよう}→個人用：26704_kojinyou⟧: for personal use — focuses on individual rather than household
